biggest_catch: Official page is terms-thin: it confirms a $10 Amazon gift card per qualifying referral but publishes no friend-side qualification details beyond opening a new checking account, no annual cap, and no payout timing or tax treatment.
catches: No annual or lifetime referral cap is stated on the official page.
No payout timing is published (only that a referral portal or branch coupon can be used).
Friend-side qualification is only 'results in a new checking account' with no opening-deposit or transaction requirements stated.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: West Gate Bank's official page (westgate.bank/personal/resources/tell-a-friend) runs a Tell-A-Friend program offering a thank-you gift to referrers and new account holders.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referrer earns a $10 Amazon gift card for every referral that results in a new checking account. No cap or annual limit is stated on the official page.

c3.evidence: Official page mechanics: visit the referral portal (referwestgatebank.com, linked from the official page) and send the referral electronically, or send referrals to any bank location with a Tell-A-Friend coupon.

c4.evidence: Timing: no payout timing is published on the official page; disclosed as unstated.

eligibility: West Gate Bank customers referring friends or family who open a new checking account; no further eligibility detail is published on the official page.
notes: Official page copy says both referrer and new account holder receive a free thank-you gift, but only the referrer's gift amount ($10 Amazon gift card per qualifying referral) is quantified.
payout_quote: For every referral you make that results in a new checking account, you can earn a $10 Amazon gift card.
payout_value_note: Amazon gift card, not cash; $10 per qualifying referral.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: No cost to refer; referrals can be sent via the bank's online referral portal or a branch coupon.

s3.note: Tax treatment not disclosed on the official page.

s4.note: Official terms page does not state any referral-count cap.

s5.note: Offer is live on the current official page (observed 2026-09-23); no expiration date is published.

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated on the official page: use the linked online referral portal or a Tell-A-Friend coupon at any location.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying action is only 'opens a new checking account'; no deposit, direct-deposit, or transaction minimums are published on the official page.

steps: Go to referwestgatebank.com (linked from westgate.bank) and send your referral electronically, or submit a Tell-A-Friend coupon at a branch.
Your friend opens a new West Gate Bank checking account.
You earn a $10 Amazon gift card for every referral that results in a new checking account.
timing: No payout timing is published on the official page; friend opens a new checking account via the referral portal or branch coupon.
